_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Lists staged changes, hidden route/head diffs, and ready marks; mark_ready/unmark mutate review state only.

description: Review queue: what changed and isn't live yet. list (counts first) → get one item (hidden changes, optional diff, bodyChanged: false means only title/meta/route fields changed — review hidden, not the visible page) → mark_ready / unmark (≤50 ids). Then publish_site onlyReady:true. Drafts-only sites: a person marks.

action.description: list (default) · get one item · mark_ready · unmark

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

id.description: get: item id from list (p:/path, s:key, m:menus)

ids.description: mark_ready / unmark: item ids from list (≤50)

name: review_changes
